title: The Birthday Cake
answer: C, the brother. The cake was cut at ten, long after the baker left at seven. The pink frosting was on a BLUE sleeve, and the brother was the one in the blue suit.

beats.line: Uncle Rob was found dead at his own birthday party, at half past ten.
The cake was cut at ten. Nobody saw a thing.
The baker says she left right after delivering the cake, at seven.
The best friend says she was dancing all night.
The brother, in his blue suit, says he never went near the cake.
Clue one: the baker's delivery note. Seven o'clock.
Clue two: the best friend's step counter. Over fourteen thousand steps tonight.
Clue three: pink frosting, smeared on a blue sleeve.
